dataset_spec.name: uci_cardiotocography
dataset_spec.description: UCI Cardiotocography (2126 antepartum CTG recordings, SisPorto automatic analysis). 21 features: fetal heart rate baseline, event rates per second, variability measures and FHR histogram statistics. 3-class fetal state by consensus of three obstetricians (normal, suspect, pathologic).
dataset_spec.setting: Antepartum fetal monitoring: one cardiotocogram (fetal heart rate and uterine contraction tracing) analysed automatically by the SisPorto system. The observations are the fetal heart rate baseline, the rates of accelerations, fetal movements, contractions and decelerations per second of tracing, short- and long-term variability, and the fetal heart rate histogram statistics.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Cardiotocogram features (event rates are per second of recording):

nmax.text_label: Number of fetal heart rate histogram peaks

nzeros.text_label: Number of fetal heart rate histogram zeros

nsp.question: Based on these cardiotocogram features, how did the expert obstetricians classify the fetal state of this recording?
